title: docs/<slug>/manifest.json
description: What a converter writes and the index builders read. `required` is the checker's REQUIRED_FIELDS; every other field is optional, and a manifest may carry fields not listed here. Written by the converters in scripts/ with schema_version 1.

doc_id.description: the manual this is an edition of

version.description: the tool release it applies to, as its cover prints it

version_and_later.description: present only when the cover says the document also covers later releases

extractor.description: written by convert_docling.py, for readers older than `converter`

attribution.description: rebuild_reference.py: whether chunks were attributed to entries, and from which TOC level

command.description: the entry this chunk documents (a reference); null where none

confidence.description: convert_docling.py: how the ancestors were derived

chars.description: no longer written: the file is the copy. Old manifests carry it

owns_breadcrumbs.description: the chunk breadcrumbs came from the TOC chain at conversion; enrich_chunks.py leaves them alone
